mn-app--denied: state modifier on #app-content; .mn-denied block paints the denied surface
mn-cal-day-list__item: structural <li> wrapper; .mn-cal-day-list__link paints the row card
mn-dispatch-hint: sr-only keyboard hint on the dispatch board; e2e anchor (tests/e2e/uj-journeys.spec.js)
mn-filter-field--switch: layout marker for a switch-bearing filter field; alignment via .mn-filter-field__label--spacer + .mn-switch
mn-id-directory: idListEditor field wrapper marker; .mn-field + .mn-user-picker__wrap carry the layout
mn-scope-strip__badge: BEM element marker in the scope strip; .mn-badge recipe paints it
mn-search__input: search input marker in filter panels; .mn-input + .mn-filter-field__control carry the styling
mn-user-picker__input: combobox input hook consumed by e2e (calendar.spec.js, open-dialogs-inventory.spec.js); .mn-input paints the chrome
